name: I'm Not Trying To Befriend Demons!
source:
A chaotic conversation between a girl who learnt to fight demons and a demon who can actually hold a conversation (and regrets). 

[From [url=https://zedie.itch.io/im-not-trying-to-befriend-demons]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个学过如何对付恶魔的女孩，与一个居然能够正常交谈的恶魔之间，展开了一场混乱的对话。恶魔对此后悔不已。

[摘自[url=https://zedie.itch.io/im-not-trying-to-befriend-demons]itch.io[/url]]
